stem:
A student is looking directly at a lit nightlight through two different cardboard tubes as shown.

Through which tube, if any, will the light be seen and why?

options.label: A
options.text: The bent tube only because the light bounces off the sides of the tube and travels through the tube to the student's eye

options.label: B
options.text: The straight tube only because the light travels in a straight line directly to the student's eye

options.label: C
options.text: Both tubes because light travels equally well along straight and curved paths

options.label: D
options.text: Neither tube because both tubes absorb all of the light

visual_elements: Bent tube labeled tube held by student looking at light
Straight tube labeled tube held by student looking at light
